examples.text: Toen de pathologe zag dat lijkrovers haar mortuarium plunderden, zaagde zij voor straf en als trofee hun armen af.
examples.translation: When the pathologist saw that body snatchers were plundering her morgue, she sawed off their arms as a punishment and a trophy.
examples.english: When the pathologist saw that body snatchers were plundering her morgue, she sawed off their arms as a punishment and a trophy.
